chunks.arabic_text: الْفَقِيهُ: بِإِسْنَادِهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ كَانَ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ

translations.en: Al-Faqih: Via his chain from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that: Ali (peace be upon him) was in the Masjid of Kufa

chunks.arabic_text: فَمَرَّ بِهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ قَفْلٍ التَّائِمِي وَمَعَهُ دِرْعُ طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: هَذِهِ دِرْعُ طَلْحَةَ أُخِذَتْ غُلُولًا يَوْمَ الْبَصْرَةِ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ قَفْلٍ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اجْعَلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ قَاضِيكَ الَّذِي ارْتَضَيْتَهُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ فَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ شُرَيْحٌ، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: هَذِهِ دِرْعُ طَلْحَةَ أُخِذَتْ غُلُولًا يَوْمَ الْبَصْرَةِ، فَقَالَ شُرَيْحٌ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ هَاتِ عَلَى مَا تَقُولُ بَيِّنَةً، فَأَتَاهُ بِالْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَشَهِدَ أَنَّهَا دِرْعُ طَلْحَةَ أُخِذَتْ يَوْمَ الْبَصْرَةِ غُلُولًا، فَقَالَ شُرَيْحٌ: هَذَا شَاهِدٌ وَلَا أَقْضِي بِشَاهِدٍ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مَعَهُ آخَرُ، فَأَتَى بِقَنْبَرَ فَشَهِدَ أَنَّهَا دِرْعُ طَلْحَةَ أُخِذَتْ غُلُولًا يَوْمَ الْبَصْرَةِ، فَقَالَ: هَذَا مَمْلُوكٌ وَلَا أَقْضِي بِشَهَادَةِ الْمَمْلُوكِ، فَغَضِبَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: خُذُوا الدِّرْعَ فَإِنَّ هَذَا قَدْ قَضَى بِجَوْرٍ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَتَحَوَّلَ شُرَيْحٌ عَنْ مَجْلِسِهِ وَقَالَ: لَا أَقْضِي بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ حَتَّى تُخْبِرَنِي مِنْ أَيْنَ قَضَيْتَ بِجَوْرٍ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: إِنِّي لَمَّا قُلْتُ لَكَ: إِنَّهَا دِرْعُ طَلْحَةَ أُخِذَتْ غُلُولًا يَوْمَ الْبَصْرَةِ فَقُلْتَ هَاتِ عَلَى مَا تَقُولُ بَيِّنَةً، وَقَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: حَيْثُمَا وُجِدَ غُلُولٌ أُخِذَ بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ، فَقُلْتُ: رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ الْحَدِيثَ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُكَ بِالْحَسَنِ فَشَهِدَ فَقُلْتَ: هَذَا شَاهِدٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلَا أَقْضِي بِشَاهِدٍ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مَعَهُ آخَرُ، وَقَدْ قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِشَاهِدٍ وَيَمِينٍ، فَهَاتَانِ اثْنَتَانِ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُكَ بِقَنْبَرَ فَشَهِدَ فَقُلْتَ: هَذَا مَمْلُوكٌ، وَمَا بَأْسَ بِشَهَادَةِ الْمَمْلُوكِ إِذَا كَانَ عَدْلًا، فَهَذِهِ الثَّالِثَةُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: يَا شُرَيْحُ إِنَّ إِمَامَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يُؤْتَمَنُ مِنْ أُمُورِهِمْ عَلَى مَا هُوَ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ هَذَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: فَأَوَّلُ مَنْ رَدَّ شَهَادَةَ الْمَمْلُوكِ رُمَا.

translations.en: when Abdullah ibn Quf al-Taymi passed by him with the armor of Talha. Ali (peace be upon him) said: This is the armor of Talha which was taken as spoil of war (ghulul) on the day of Basra. Ibn Quf said: O Commander of the Faithful, appoint between us and you the judge whom you have chosen for the Muslims. So he appointed Shurayh between them. Ali (peace be upon him) said: This is the armor of Talha which was taken as spoil of war on the day of Basra. Shurayh said: O Commander of the Faithful, bring proof for what you say. He was brought al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him) who testified that it was the armor of Talha taken as spoil of war on the day of Basra. Shurayh said: This is one witness, and I do not rule based on a single witness unless there is another with him. He was brought Qanbar who testified that it was the armor of Talha taken as spoil of war on the day of Basra. He said: This is a slave, and I do not rule based on the testimony of a slave. Ali (peace be upon him) became angry and said: Take the armor, for this one [Shurayh] has ruled with injustice three times. Shurayh moved from his seat and said: I will not judge between two until you tell me from where I have ruled with injustice three times? Ali (peace be upon him) said to him: When I said to you: 'It is the armor of Talha taken as spoil of war on the day of Basra,' you said: 'Bring proof for what you say,' while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had said: 'Wherever spoil of war is found, it is taken without proof,' I said: 'The man has not heard the Hadith.' Then I brought you al-Hasan who testified, so you said: 'This is one witness, and I do not rule based on a single witness unless there is another with him,' while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to rule based on a witness and an oath. These are two. Then I brought you Qanbar who testified, so you said: 'This is a slave,' but there is no harm in the testimony of a slave if he is just. This is the third. Then he (peace be upon him) said: O Shurayh, the Imam of the Muslims is entrusted with their affairs in matters greater than this. Then Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The first to reject the testimony of a slave was Rumā.

en.summary: This hadith from *Al-Faqih* illustrates the jurisprudential tension between Ali ibn Abi Talib’s authoritative, precedent-based approach and Shurayh’s emerging emphasis on strict evidentiary formalism. By rejecting the testimony of al-Hasan, Qanbar, and a slave on technical grounds, Shurayh demonstrates the early development of *qada'* (judiciary) principles, while Ali’s rebuttal highlights the flexibility of prophetic tradition (*Sunnah*) in matters of spoils of war (*ghulul*). The narrative serves as a critical reference in Shia scholarship for understanding the validity of diverse witness types and the superior status of the Imam’s judgment.
en.seo_question: What were the three legal errors Shurayh made in judging the case of Talha's armor according to Ali (peace be upon him)?

key_terms.غُلُول: Spoil of war taken treacherously or before final division

عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: حَيْثُمَا وُجِدَ غُلُولٌ أُخِذَ بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ، فَقُلْتُ: رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ الْحَدِيثَ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُكَ بِالْحَسَنِ فَشَهِدَ فَقُلْتَ: هَذَا شَاهِدٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلَا أَقْضِي بِشَاهِدٍ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مَعَهُ آخَرُ، وَقَدْ قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِشَاهِدٍ وَيَمِينٍ، فَهَاتَانِ اثْنَتَانِ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُكَ بِقَنْبَرَ فَشَهِدَ فَقُلْتَ: هَذَا مَمْلُوكٌ، وَمَا بَأْسَ بِشَهَادَةِ الْمَمْلُوكِ إِذَا كَانَ عَدْلًا، فَهَذِهِ الثَّالِثَةُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: يَا شُرَيْحُ إِنَّ إِمَامَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يُؤْتَمَنُ مِنْ أُمُورِهِمْ عَلَى مَا هُوَ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ هَذَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: فَأَوَّلُ مَنْ رَدَّ شَهَادَةَ الْمَمْلُوكِ رُمَا.
